verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an AI API platform, but the evidence documents only request-driven capabilities: agent instructions, tools, function calling, profiles and model fallback. Nothing shows user-defined rules that fire actions automatically when events occur. The 'instructions' system-prompt rules apply per turn within a request and are not event triggers, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
